geography: Outside the U.S. (EEA, Latin America, Middle East and other territories); Translarna is not approved in the U.S.
moa: Nonsense-mutation readthrough agent (ribosomal readthrough of premature stop codons)

approval_evidence.quote: Translarna received marketing authorization from the European Commission in August 2014 for the treatment of nonsense mutation Duchenne muscular dystrophy

launch_evidence.quote: We commenced our commercial launch of Translarna in Germany in December 2014

series_start_reason: Commercial launch in Germany in December 2014; 2014Q4 is the first quarter PTC prints net product revenue for its own quarter. A 2014Q3 amount of 81 thousand (early access programme sales) appears only as a prior-year comparative in later filings; the 10-Q for September 30, 2014 prints no product revenue line.
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1070081 (PTC Therapeutics) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched every 10-Q/10-K and every exhibit of each 8-K with item 2.02 filed 2014-01 to 2026-11 and searched for 'Translarna' and 'ataluren'.

2014Q4-2017Q1: 'Net product revenue' line (Translarna sole product) from the 10-Q statements of operations (Q1-Q3) and the three-month column of the Q4 release. 2017Q2 onward: the financial-highlights text of each quarter's own release ('Translarna net product sales/revenues were $X million for the ... quarter of YYYY'; '(ataluren)' added from 2025Q4), because the statements print only the Translarna-plus-Emflaza total.
